description: This file defines a JobService implementation for Android's JobScheduler API. It manages background jobs, communicates status updates to an activity via Messenger, and handles job lifecycle events such as starting and stopping jobs.

classes.name: MyJobService
classes.description: An Android JobService that handles scheduling, execution, and communication related to background jobs, including updating the UI via Messenger.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and logs its creation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the service and logs its destruction.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Stores a Messenger for activity communication when the service is started.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Handles the start of a job, schedules a delayed finish, and updates the activity.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Handles job interruption and cleanup, updating the activity accordingly.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends status messages to the activity via Messenger.
